<function name="RenderAngles" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the angle that the clients view is being rendered at. Returns `angles` from the return value of <page>render.GetViewSetup</page>.

See also <page>Global.EyeAngles</page>.
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">Render Angles</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
